en: Oh, Rantaro...?

What in the world!?
What the hell is going on!?
Ah...aah...aaahh...
GYAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Right after Tenko screamed, the front door of
the library burst open...

<CLT=cltMIND>...and the four people who were in the
Game Room rushed in.
Wh-What happen? Gonta hear scream—

Waaaaaaaahhhh!!!
B-Blood...! So much blood!
Nyeeeh...?

Huhhhh? Isn't that Rantaro?
What's wrong with him?
...He's dead.

Whaaaat? He's dead?
Well, that's unfortunate.
How can you be so calm!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi examined Rantaro's body and placed his
hand close to his mouth to check for breathing.
...We're too late.
<CLT=cltMIND>He shook his head.
T-Too late...? You mean...dead?
H-He's dead...?

<CLT=cltMIND>My vision began to swirl...
My legs wobbled beneath me...

<CLT=cltMIND>But out of sheer desperation, I kept
my mind working.
<CLT=cltMIND>Why was Rantaro here?
<CLT=cltMIND>And...
<CLT=cltMIND>The monitor is off.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was no longer displaying Monokuma
anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>Does that mean...the mastermind is dead?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah, that has to be it.
This means, Rantaro was—
This means the killing game has started, huh?
What?

K-Killing game!? Then someone killed
Rantaro and—
Wait, maybe not.
What do you mean, maybe not!?

Maybe the killing game hasn't started...
Maybe...this just ended it.
Ended it? What do you mean?

...The mastermind.
Rantaro was the mastermind.
What!? The <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?

...I don't know how he died, but if Rantaro
was in the library before the time limit ended...

There's a high chance that the mastermind
planned this. And if he's dead...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong, dong ding!*
...What?
A body has been discovered!
Everyone, please gather in the library!

What a relief. A murder took place just
before time ran out!
M-Monokuma!? But how!?

I gotta admit, I was a little nervous there
cuz the killing game hadn't started yet.

Geez...you guys really know how to keep
me in suspense.
H-How? The mastermind controlling you is...

Hm? By mastermind, do you mean the real
mastermind who's controlling me?
And you think it was Rantaro?

Ahhh, what an imagination!
Of course that's wrong!

If the mastermind had died, this killing game
would be over.
B-But...

The victim was Rantaro Amami, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
"Who Cares?"<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Nothing more, nothing less.
Wh-What are you talking about?

Shuichi, what does he mean?
What's going to happen...?

He... Monokuma is wrong, isn't he...?
Isn't Rantaro the mastermind?

Yeah! We came here as soon as the sensor
went off, right?

No one else was in the library... Rantaro was
the only one who could've moved the bookcase...

Wouldn't that mean he was trying to use that
hidden door, and that he was the mastermind?

But if he was the mastermind...why is
the killing game not over...?
Why...? Why is he dead...?

It's no good, I don't know,
I don't know...
Shuichi...?

Ah! The pictures!
We can check the pictures!

I'm sure that the cameras we
set up in the library will give us a clue—

<CLT=cltMIND>At that moment, the library door swung
wide open...
Kyaaaaaaaah!
Rantaro!? But...why!?

Hrk...! Th-That's Rantaro? Oh, thank god!
I thought that was a pile of dirty rags!

I see...
So this ended up happening after all.

Kehehe...my, my. What a world this is, 
so full of jokes like this.

Wh-What...? This is a lie, right?
My dearest Rantaro is dea—
Oh, I mean...
...was kiiiiiiiiiiiiiiilled!!!
That's the same thing...
Hmph... How ironic.

The guy who wanted to live ended up dead...
and the guy who wanted to die survived.

So...can somebody explain the meaning of
all this?
Nah. An explanation isn't necessary.

Thanks to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>First Blood Perk<CLT=cltNORMAL>, there won't be
a class trial, so that'd just be a waste of time.

With that said...if you're the blackened who
killed Rantaro, raise your hand!
The one who...killed Rantaro?

I knew it! A degenerate male killed Rantaro,
didn't he!?
How you know boy do it!?

I just know, okay!? Violent crimes are almost
always committed by violent, disgusting men!

Tch... That dumbass!
How dare he go and get himself killed!

Who the hell did it!?
I'll friggin' punch you into orbit!

Puhuhu... Don't get so angry. Send off your
graduating classmate with warm farewells.

Or send 'em off with hostility like a bunch of
catty popular girls! That's fine, too!

But if it's gonna disrupt the process, then
we're gonna bust out the Exisals!

Ughhh... I'm not gonna look... I don't wanna
look at a nasty, dead body...

Slurrrp! Nothing beats crashing a funeral!
It's way better than wedding crashing!

I'll throw in a wedding every now and then, but
funerals are insane! Like fishin' with dynamite!

So whoever did this really gets to graduate,
huh?

Heck yeah! I'm a real stickler for the rules!
I'm also tough on convenience store clerks!

Then congratulations! Would the blackened who's
about to graduate please raise their hand!
<CLT=cltMIND>...
What the—? No one's raisin' their hand?

Hey, didja hear me? All the blackened has to
do to graduate is speak up, y'know?
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Hm? No one's stepping forward.
What's going on?
Puhuhu... I see how it is.

The blackened has no need for the First Blood
Perk. They would rather do a class trial.
Excuse me?
Very well, then.

I will give the blackened what they want and
hold a class trial!
Wow!
Now this is a spicy twist!
W-Wait... What the heck's going on?

Like we said before, we're gonna hold a class
trial so you bastards can find Rantaro's killer.

Get it right and only the blackened will be
punished. But if you get it wrong—

Simultaneous surgery! Brain and knee!
Then brain surgery again!

...Everyone besides the blackened will be
punished.

Everyone besides the blackened...
Everyone...

This outcome is much worse. The culprit
should have just stepped forward.

But before we can hold the class trial, you
gotta <CLT=cltSTRONG>investigate<CLT=cltNORMAL> first.

If you don't investigate the murder, you won't
be able to argue over who did it.

So you're saying we need to do the 
investigation ourselves, too?

Of course! The investigation is what makes
the killing game so good!

You guys are gonna investigate this crime
and uncover the truth!

Puhuhu... The blackened's handiwork has made
this much more entertaining than I expected...

All right! The trial will begin soon, so please
give the investigation your all!
Let's get going then!
W-Wait...where do we start?

We're looking for the truth of Rantaro's death, 
right?

If we can't figure out who the culprit is,
then we'll be annihilated for sure.

I-I don't wanna be annihilated!
The girls should be allowed to live, at least!

Nyeeeh... I'm just a cute, normal girl who 
can use magic, y'know?

You're the last person who should be callin'
herself <CLT=cltSTRONG>cute<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Do not fret. Just imagine this as something out
of a police drama or detective manga.
Right, Shuichi?
R-Right...

I'm in trouble... I've never watched police
dramas or read detective manga!

Well...there's no need to think so hard.
We need only converse with the corpse...

A corpse is not simply a dead person.
That is just an assumption made by the living.

Yes! By coming face to face with the corpse,
you will learn a great many things!

Why are you getting excited!?
You're not into dead bodies, are you!?
But...is it true? Is one of us really the culprit?

...The odds are one in fifteen. That shouldn't
be hard to figure out.
That's not the problem here!

Wh-Who's the fuckin' culprit, huh!?
Is it you!? Or maybe it's you!

Eeeny, meeny, miney, moe...
Who's the killer? Only Atua knows...
You no can choose that way!

Ah-haha, everyone's competing to see who's
the most paranoid. Yeah, that's not boring.

Wait... Wait, stop! We can't do this!
We can't go back and forth accusing each other!

For now...we need to trust each other
and start a serious investigation.
Huh?

If we all lose our trust in one another
because of this...it's all over!

We have to believe in each other
and investigate this case.

Investigating is the same thing as not
trusting each other.

No, it's completely different from what
Monokuma wants us to do.

He wants us to throw accusations at one
another, and lose all trust in each other...
And we...can't let him get what he wants.

We need to investigate this murder. Not because
we don't trust each other, but because we *do*.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
Ah...did I...say something wrong?
You were just so...direct and assertive.
Ah, no, I just...said what was on my mind...

You really are a detective! Now that we need to
investigate, you're becoming super reliable!

I agree with Shuichi. Actually, he just said 
exactly what I was gonna say!

Males are degenerate creatures who betray
others easily, but I'll trust you this time...

The only good thing about males is that
girls give birth to them!

Gonta not smart. Not sure Gonta be much
help. But Gonta do his best for everyone!

I will work hard with Atua's guidance.
I'm much happier alive than dead anyway.

As novice investigators, logic dictates that we
work together rather than give in to paranoia.

If this is what everyone desires...then I shall
give this task my all.

You can leave it to me!
I'll find the culprit in no time!

<CLT=cltMIND>Phew, I'm glad.
No one's given up yet.
<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah...of course they haven't.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't change what has already happened.
All I can do is what must be done.
<CLT=cltMIND>Otherwise...Rantaro died for nothing.
<CLT=cltMIND>I have to do it. I won't give up.

<CLT=cltMIND>We'll all escape from here!
I'll make sure of it!
So, let's get started.

We need to do this. So poor Rantaro won't 
have any regrets...and so we can survive.
Yes... Let's find the culprit who killed Rantaro.
You're right! Let's do it!
<CLT=cltMIND>Thank you, Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>So much has happened in such a short time, and
I haven't been able to keep up with everything...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I know that I need to fight back against this
class trial to protect everyone!

<CLT=cltMIND>The last time I saw Rantaro...he was alive
and well...
Why...did Rantaro die here?
What do you mean...die here?

I mean, if Rantaro was the one
who moved the bookcase...

That would mean he came all the way over
here after the bookcase opened.

He moved *away* from the hidden door...to
this spot. Why would he do that...?

And there's no trace of his body
being moved. It...doesn't add up.

Ah, are you okay?
You've gone pale...

...Although I guess that's normal.
We have to investigate a body, after all...

The body of someone who was alive
and talking to us, just a little while ago...

I-It's okay, really...
We just have to do our best.

Not just for Rantaro's sake...but also so we
can avenge him...
And...so we can protect everyone else.

We have to defeat the mastermind who's
orchestrating this whole thing.

Um, Kaede...I'll help you in any way I can.
I'll support you for this investigation.
I am...sort of a detective, after all.
Sort of? You *are* a detective, remember?
Ah, right...

Rantaro opened the bookcase, but he moved
*away* from the hidden door...to this spot.
Why would he do that?
And there's no trace of his body being moved.

It...doesn't add up.
Why did Rantaro die here?

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like I'm missing something...
I should investigate a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is displaying the stopped
countdown for the time limit...

<CLT=cltMIND>When the countdown stopped, all that obnoxious
noise stopped, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what would've happened if the
time limit had expired...
<CLT=cltMIND>A bloody shot put ball is on the ground.
This shot put ball... Could it be...?

Yeah, it definitely came from <CLT=cltSTRONG>the warehouse
on the 1st floor<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
There's blood all over it...

That's the murder weapon, right? I don't see
anything else that could've been used.

The shot itself is heavy... You would have
to be fairly strong to use it as a weapon.
<CLT=cltMIND>Fairly strong, huh?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Bloody Shot Put Ball<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>A bloody shot put ball is on the ground. It came
from the warehouse on the 1st floor.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's caked with blood... There's no doubt
that this was the murder weapon.

Um...I know we need to examine his body, but
I'm not sure where to start.
...It's okay. I...can do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi showed no hesitation as he began
to examine Rantaro's body.

There's blood on the back of his head.
It looks like a pretty deep wound.
It's consistent with blunt force trauma.

I don't see any other injuries... The Monokuma
File is accurate. This must be the fatal wound.
So...we can trust the Monokuma File?
Yes...for now...

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi then stuck his hand into Rantaro's
pocket.
Wait! What are you doing!?

I'm checking what he has on his person.
There might be a clue.

If we're going to do this, we have to be thorough.
I told you I would support you, after all...

H-H-How can you say that with so much...
c-confidence?
<CLT=cltMIND>C'mon, Kaede... Pull yourself together.

Rantaro had in his possession the key to his
room and the student handbook Monopad.

The Monopad is definitely his, and it's
exactly the same model as ours.
He didn't have a card key on him?

That's what I was thinking...
but he didn't have it.
Then...Rantaro really wasn't the mastermind.

If he was the mastermind, he wouldn't
have come here without the card key.

So, with what we know now...
that is the most likely possibility.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why was Rantaro here if he wasn't
the mastermind...?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Rantaro's Belongings<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Shuichi, can you tell me about Rantaro's
body again?

Yeah... The probable cause of death is the
deep wound on the back of Rantaro's head.

I'm positive that he was struck by
some kind of blunt weapon.

In Rantaro's pockets, I found his room key
and the student handbook Monopad.

He doesn't have any kind of
card key on him.

Which is why I believe it is safe to say that
Rantaro is not the mastermind.
...That's all I know right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why was Rantaro here if he wasn't
the mastermind...?
Organized Books

...Kaede, are you okay?
We've...finished investigating the body...
Let's get out of here for now, okay?
Y-Yeah...sorry.
